answer.value:
Benefits of the Eightfold Path Taught by Gautama Buddha
The Eightfold Path taught by Gautama Buddha helps people:
Overcome suffering.
Learn how to cope with life's pressures and challenges.
Develop positive thoughts and make wise decisions.
Manage stress effectively.
Build a better and more meaningful life through right conduct and understanding.

questions.text: Which values can you adopt from the teachings of Buddha and Mahavira, in your life? Explain.
questions.text_as_printed: Which values can you adopt from the teachings of Buddha and Mahavira, in your life? Explain. (A)

answer.value:
Values That Can Be Adopted from the Teachings of Buddha and Mahavira
The teachings of Buddha and Mahavira encourage the following values:
Ability to overcome suffering.
Learning to manage life's pressures and difficulties.
Developing positive thinking and sound decision-making.
Non-violence (Ahimsa).
Simple living.
Self-reflection and introspection.
Following moral and ethical principles.
Integrity and self-discipline.
Compassion, harmony, and peace.
Encouragement of spiritual growth and development.

questions.text: List the values in the teachings of Buddhism and Jainism that are relevant even today.
questions.text_as_printed: List the values in the teachings of Buddhism and Jainism that are relevant even today. (D)

answer.value:
Buddha's Teachings can help us to solve contemporary global problems
Buddha's teachings have the potential to address many contemporary global issues.
They promote peace and non-violence, helping to reduce wars and conflicts.
The principles of Buddhism and Jainism can help combat terrorism and violence.
They encourage moderation and reduce excessive desires and greed.
These teachings promote compassion, understanding, and tolerance among people.
Economic inequalities can be reduced through ethical living and social responsibility.
They contribute to global peace and harmony.
They encourage self-control and responsible behaviour.
Their emphasis on moral values can help create a more peaceful and balanced world.
